name: 60462 · Orland Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60462 (Orland Park) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60462 (Orland Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
